description:
Add the module's single listing of a repository's worktrees, parsed once, so worktree commands and lease validation read one listing.

## Background

- Two parsers read `git worktree list --porcelain`. `parse_git_worktree_porcelain` (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:90-123`) keeps paths and branch names and drops entries without a `branch` line; `jit worktree list` uses it (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:232`). `check_worktree_exists` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:2422-2463`) reads only the `worktree` lines, once per lease.
- The porcelain format is blank-line-separated blocks of `worktree <path>`, `HEAD <oid>`, and `branch refs/heads/<name>`, `detached` or `bare`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::list_worktrees()` starts one `git worktree list --porcelain` process and returns each worktree's path and branch name, the branch absent when the worktree is detached or bare.
- [hard] REQ-02: The behaviour suite covers a primary checkout with linked, detached and slash-named-branch worktrees and counts one process per listing.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: One worktree listing in the git module
